info.name: SIRMS - Service 8 - Notification and Alert Management (Karim Hajj Ali)
info.description: Notification and Alert Management Service for the Security Incident Detection and Response Management System. Implemented by Karim Hajj Ali. Run the Authentication folder first to populate the tokens.

item.name: 0. Authentication (run first)
item.description: Logs in as each role and saves the tokens. Authentication belongs to Service 1 and is included here only so this collection can be run on its own.

request.description: Creates a notification for a user. Administrators only. Notifications are also generated automatically by Service 3 when an incident is assigned, and by Service 7 when a High or Critical vulnerability is registered.

{
  "user_id": 3,
  "title": "Quarterly access review due",
  "message": "Please review the access rights for the systems you administer.",
  "notification_type": "System Notification",
  "severity": "Low"
}
